{{Quote|I will take what Jedi we have left and go to Geonosis and help Obi-Wan.|Mace Windu|audio=Windu-WhatJedi.flac|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
'''Sephjet Josall''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Jedi Knight]] in [[Jedi Order]]. In [[22 BBY]], Josall was part of a [[Jedi assault team]] that [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] led to the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] to [[First Battle of Geonosis|rescue]] [[Jedi]] Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had been captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

Josall and the other Jedi infiltrated the [[Petranaki Arena]], where Kenobi was to be publicly [[Death|executed]] alongside his [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], and then revealed themselves to battle Separatist [[battle droid]]s. During the fighting, Josall provided Kenobi with a [[lightsaber]] while fellow Jedi Knight [[Nicanas Tassu]] armed Skywalker. The Jedi took heavy [[Death|casualties]] during the battle but ultimately claimed victory with aid from [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone reinforcements]].

==Biography==
Sephjet Josall was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="SWFC" /> who served in the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[Republic Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="AOTC" /> and attained the rank of [[Jedi Knight]].<ref name="SWFC" /> During the [[Separatist Crisis]]<ref name="AOTC" /> in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Timelinse">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Josall was part of<ref name="AOTC" /> an [[Jedi assault team|assault team]] of 212 [[Jedi]]<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> that [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] led to the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]]  with the goal of rescuing Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had been captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Kenobi had been brought to the [[Petranaki Arena]] on Geonosis along with his [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] to be publicly [[Death|executed]] by a trio of beasts. As the [[prisoner]]s fought for their lives against the creatures, Josall and the other assault team members infiltrated the arena and then revealed themselves when Windu confronted Confederacy leader [[Count]] [[Dooku]].<ref name="AOTC" />

Josall was among the Jedi who descended to the arena floor, where numerous Separatist [[battle droid]]s emerged to fight them. Alongside fellow Jedi Knight [[Nicanas Tassu]], Josall made his way to Kenobi, Skywalker, and Amidala, who were riding on the back of a [[reek]] they had gained control over. Josall then threw a spare lightsaber he was carrying to the unarrmed Kenobi, with Tassu providing a blade to Skywalker. As the fighting continued, many Jedi perished and eventually the surviving Jedi still fighting on the arena floor were surrounded by [[droid]]s, with Josall and Tassu not among their number. A [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]] then arrived to reinforce the Jedi, allowing them to gain the upper hand and defeat the Separatist forces.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
Josall had [[Color|tan]] skin, brown [[eye]]s, and while on Geonosis had a bald head.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Equipment==
[[File:JosallLightsaber.png|thumb|right|200px|Josall's secondary lightsaber]]
While fighting on Geonosis, Josall wore brown and tan [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]] including a brown [[belt]]. He used a blue-bladed lightsaber himself and provided a second blue-bladed saber to Kenobi.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sephjet Josall was portrayed by assistant editor [[Joseph Jett Sally]]<ref name="Insider77">{{InsiderCite|77|Star Wars Q&A|Ask the Master}}</ref> in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> The Jedi battle in the Geonosis Arena scenes were filmed on Stage 3 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]], between [[August 10]] and [[August 15]], [[2000]].<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Josall's name was used in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'',<ref name="SWFC" /> which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates<ref name="Force Collection release">{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}}</ref> the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivedate=20210505080831}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the [[Sephjet Josall/Legends|character]] was first identified by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] in his "[[Star Wars Q&A|Ask the Master]]" column in the [[Star Wars Insider 77|seventy-seventh issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Insider77" /> which was published on [[August 3]], [[2004]].<ref name="Fan">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040713.html|text=Top Ten Trilogy Moments in ''Insider'' #77}}</ref> Hidalgo confirmed the name was based on Jett Sally's name.<ref name="Insider77" />
